title: Fix a non-atomic read-modify-write race (CUDA)
info: Real CUDA-C compiled by arena.cuda_c.CudaProgram, executed on arena.cuda_sim.GPU.
256 threads, single block, each meant to contribute 1.0 to a running count.

This simulator (like the CUDA-C subset it models) has no atomicAdd; the fix must restructure the algorithm (privatize per-thread, then reduce), not add more synchronization around the shared read-modify-write.
